messages.subject: For Tobias Meyer | Global logistics, government relations and country stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear DHL Group Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Tobias Meyer, Chief Executive Officer.

DHL Group's global logistics network depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, infrastructure partners, customers and country stakeholders. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex operating environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and cross-functional stakeholder matters across corporate and technical teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support DHL Group's government-affairs, external-relations or country-strategy priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to DHL Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
